text: Do not participate in bullying—stop it. Train your child: screenshot → tell me → report to the platform. The one who remains silent is a partner (in the wrongdoing).

review_defects.english: The one who remains silent is a partner (in the wrongdoing).
review_defects.why: The English adds '(in the wrongdoing)' which is not present in the Arabic, inserting an interpretation that narrows the original statement.
